title: Simlab lab-like content item (lab, drill, incident)
description: Specified in docs/SCENARIO_FORMAT.md. The check, fault and step catalogs in $defs are the phase 00 catalog; from phase 09 they are generated from the plugin registry.

prose.description: Markdown, or a list of blocks of prose and figures (docs/SCENARIO_FORMAT.md §10, §11)

entityRef.description: `<Kind>/<name>` as the view names them; `*` matches any run of characters

on.description: The id of a diagram entity

apply.description: YAML documents, applied as `kubectl apply -f -` by the cluster admin.

run.description: The command line, typed into a shell as a person would.

on.description: Machine to act on; default: the entry machine.

as.description: User to act as; default: the entry user on the entry machine, root elsewhere.

expect.description: The exit status the command must end with; default 0.

editor.description: Answers the editor the command opens: operations applied to the content it opened with; the result is saved.

replace.description: Replace the first occurrence of `from` with `to`; fails when `from` is absent.

write.description: The whole new content of the buffer.

path.description: Absolute, or relative to the home directory of the user `as`.

mode.description: Permission bits in octal; default as the user creates files (umask 022).

group.description: Group; default the owner's primary group.

on.description: Machine to act on; default: the entry machine.

as.description: User to act as; default: the entry user on the entry machine, root elsewhere.

oneOf.title: until
oneOf.description: Let time pass until the check holds; fails if it does not within `timeout`.

exists.description: Whether the file must exist; default true. With false, no other property is allowed.

type.description: The file type; `symlink` looks at the link itself, the others follow links.

matches.description: The content matches this regular expression (multi-line).

with.description: The Service's EndpointSlices hold that many ready endpoints (default: at least one), counted by unique address. A missing Service fails.

count.description: Exactly this many. Excludes min and max.

with.description: Every listed Node carries a taint with the key (and the value and effect, when given). A missing Node fails.
The object exists now with the metadata.uid it had after setup: it was not deleted, nor deleted and created again. An object absent after setup is an error in the item.

kind.description: The kind, as in a manifest: Deployment, ConfigMap, Node.

apiVersion.description: The group version (apps/v1, v1). Default: the first group version serving the kind, core first.

namespace.description: The namespace of a namespaced kind (default: default). Not allowed for a cluster-scoped kind.

with.description: The objects of a kind selected by name, by selector, or all in the namespace (cluster-wide for a cluster-scoped kind), terminating ones included, exist in the expected number (default: at least one; with exists: false, none) and every where clause holds for each.

kind.description: The kind, as in a manifest: Deployment, ConfigMap, Node.

apiVersion.description: The group version (apps/v1, v1). Default: the first group version serving the kind, core first.

namespace.description: The namespace of a namespaced kind (default: default). Not allowed for a cluster-scoped kind.

name.description: One object by name. Excludes selector.

selector.description: A label selector (app=web,tier!=db), parsed by the API server. Excludes name.

exists.description: false: no selected object exists (then count, min, max and where are not allowed). Default true.

count.description: Exactly this many. Excludes min and max.

items.description: A JSONPath and exactly one operator. A path that yields several values holds when every value satisfies the operator; one that yields nothing fails every operator except exists: false and notEquals.

equals.description: The value, compared as the text kubectl -o jsonpath prints (3 matches 3 and "3"); objects and lists compare as JSON.

notEquals.description: Not this value (compared like equals). Holds when the path yields nothing.

in.description: One of these values (compared like equals).

contains.description: A substring of a string value, or an element of a list value.

matches.description: A JavaScript regular expression the text of the value matches (unanchored).

exists.description: true: the path yields at least one value; false: it yields none.

gte.description: A number (or numeric string) greater than or equal to this.

lte.description: A number (or numeric string) less than or equal to this.

where.description: Clauses every selected object must satisfy.

with.description: The number of Pods matching the selector that have condition Ready=True and no deletionTimestamp (default: at least one).

selector.description: A label selector (app=web), parsed by the API server.

count.description: Exactly this many. Excludes min and max.

with.description: The rollout is complete in the sense of kubectl rollout status: every replica updated, no old replica left, every updated replica available, and the progress deadline not exceeded.

kind.description: The workload kind. Default Deployment; StatefulSet and DaemonSet arrive with phase 18a.

with.description: The objects selected after setup (by name, selector, or all of the kind in the namespace) are the objects selected now, with the same metadata.uid, and every path yields the same values. Nothing selected after setup is an error in the item.

kind.description: The kind, as in a manifest: Deployment, ConfigMap, Node.

apiVersion.description: The group version (apps/v1, v1). Default: the first group version serving the kind, core first.

namespace.description: The namespace of a namespaced kind (default: default). Not allowed for a cluster-scoped kind.

name.description: One object by name. Excludes selector.

selector.description: A label selector (app=web,tier!=db), parsed by the API server. Excludes name.

paths.description: JSONPaths in kubectl -o jsonpath syntax ({.spec.taints}) whose values must not change.

run.description: The command line, run in a new shell on the fork.

on.description: Machine to act on; default: the entry machine.

as.description: User to act as; default: the entry user on the entry machine, root elsewhere.

exit.description: The exit status it must end with; default 0.

stdout.description: What standard output must satisfy; every key given must hold.

equals.description: Equal, after removing one trailing newline.

matches.description: Matches this regular expression (JavaScript syntax, multi-line: ^ and $ match at line ends).

stderr.description: What standard error must satisfy; every key given must hold.

equals.description: Equal, after removing one trailing newline.

matches.description: Matches this regular expression (JavaScript syntax, multi-line: ^ and $ match at line ends).
